subject: English
passage: Medieval European monks were renowned for their meticulous attention to detail and unwavering dedication to preserving knowledge, traits they demonstrated even during times of crisis. ______ when Viking raiders attacked the monastery at Lindisfarne in 793 CE, the monks carefully buried their most precious manuscripts before fleeing, ensuring that the illuminated Lindisfarne Gospels survived intact.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer. "For instance" logically signals that the careful preservation of manuscripts during the Viking attack is an example supporting the previous claim—that the monks demonstrated meticulous attention and dedication even during times of crisis.
